t: The funeral prayer Abu Hurayrah described when asked
a: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّهُ عَبْدُكَ وَابْنُ عَبْدِكَ وَابْنُ أَمَتِكَ كَانَ يَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ وَأَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كَانَ مُحْسِنًا فَزِدْ فِي إِحْسَانِهِ وَإِنْ كَانَ مُسِيئًا فَتَجَاوَزْ عَنْ سَيِّئَاتِهِ
p: Allāhumma innahu ʿabduka wa-bnu ʿabdika wa-bnu amatik, kāna yashhadu an lā ilāha illā ant, wa anna Muḥammadan ʿabduka wa rasūluk, wa anta aʿlamu bih. Allāhumma in kāna muḥsinan fa-zid fī iḥsānih, wa in kāna musīʾan fa-tajāwaz ʿan sayyiʾātih
m: O Allah, he is Your servant, son of Your servant, son of Your maidservant. He used to testify that there is no god but You and that Muhammad is Your servant and Messenger, and You know him better. O Allah, if he was a doer of good, add to his good. And if he was a wrongdoer, pass over his wrongs.
